Name should change to sweet temple not spice temple
Jul 2025 • Family
Tried Spice Temple for the first time and unfortunately, it didn’t live up to the expectations. I ordered tom yum soup and fried rice—both dishes were very average in taste and nothing particularly memorable. Very sweet, What stood out more than the food was the strange order in which it was served. Soup arrived after all the main course is served , which was quite baffling and threw off the whole meal experience.

Service was also underwhelming—nothing attentive or friendly to make up for the food or the odd serving sequence. Overall, it was a disappointing visit.

Gorgeous food in a mall food court.
Aug 2023 • Couples
We wanted something light and tasty; we got it. Gorgeous Thai food in manageable portions at a very reasonable price, great smoothies and the best espresso since we left Australia a month ago. We had a “bite sized starter” that looked like a favourite and loved it - it had RAD chillies (Red And Deadly) that were east to pick out after the first piece 🤣 - tasty but hotter than most food in Vietnam. Loved it.

Good Thai Food
Apr 2023 • Friends
I met a friend for a week day lunch at Takashimaya and we picked Spice Temple as the reviews were good. 
When we asked for 2 glasses of white wine, we were told they have run out white wine by the glass.. which was a disappointing start to the meal.
We went on to order fish cake, belly pork, friend garoupa and a veg dish with 2 portions of sticky rice on the side. 
Our server checked our order twice pointing the pictures on the menu too.
We never got our veg dish nor 1 portion of sticky rice. But we were ok with that as what we got tasted amazing. The place was quite full which is an indication of the quite of food. Portions were of decent size and tasted superb

Worst meal we've had since being here
Dec 2019
You are well-versed with Thai food eat it regularly and just came from Thailand for two weeks and have been there several times with that said the quality of food was absolutely disgusting we ordered the chicken Tom yum which had fatty grissly pieces of dark meat in it absolutely disgusting I wouldn't feed to my dog then I ordered a pork and noodle dish the pork was chewy with no flavor again disgusting but my husband ordered the grilled platter everything on it was disgusting he took a few bites and we asked for our dog which they attempted to throw in charges for their napkins of 6000 and I refuse to pay for those!!! I can guarantee you that the good reviews are completely fake on this place the quality service and taste are definitely lacking!!! Don't be fooled by the beautiful pictures they do not match what you get

Food versus service
Oct 2019 • Solo
I want to start by thanking the man who sits out the front. He is keen and has great people skills. I have been to this restaurant twice: the first time the food and service were great. I went back this afternoon and the food was good (all I wanted was the banana tempura and the coconut ice cream) but the service was not good. After my encounter with the friendly chap out the front I was served by some rather rude young women. I generally do not bother with negative reviews but given this is a restaurant in the affluent part of the city they could do better.

Beautiful, tasty and plentiful
Jul 2019 • Couples
Went last night, and had more than enough food. I think we had 8 dishes between the four is us. Red and green curries were tasty, crab cakes and pad Thai were beautiful.
Everything has a spice to it so be prepared - not ridiculous but one of our friends found it a bit too spicy.
Staff are great, quick and friendly.
Hard to find spot with only a small outside sign. Very clean!
Would recommend.
